C1174.title: Fantasy Pool Platform API Business Logic Abuse Enables Theft of Referral Rewards
C1174.summary: A penetration test on a mobile Fantasy Pool platform uncovered an API business logic flaw allowing attackers to chain OTP design weaknesses, missing rate limits, and exposed internal payment endpoints into a fully automated abuse sequence. This enabled extraction of real monetary referral rewards without completing any actual payment.
